about: Dubai Marina's skyline of waterfront towers is one of the densest residential stretches in the city, and its buildings run some of the highest-utilisation shared systems in Dubai: central AC plants, elevator-fed water tanks, and marina-facing fittings that take a constant coastal breeze.

Downtown Dubai's cluster of premium towers around Burj Khalifa houses some of the city's most tightly managed residential buildings, where facilities teams expect documented, photo-verified service work rather than a quick sign-off.
